formulations.name: TET4PlasticFormulation
formulations.rationale: Plasticity integration requires spatial variation of initial yield stress, isotropic/kinematic hardening modulus, and history-dependent internal state variables across Newton-Raphson load stepping. Unimplemented paths are fail-closed.

formulations.name: CST2DFormulation
formulations.rationale: 2D plane stress/strain spatial field mapping is scheduled for V4 multi-element continuum integration.

formulations.name: Beam2DFormulation
formulations.rationale: Beam cross-sectional homogenization under spatial property variation requires fiber integration or section pre-integration.

formulations.name: Frame2DFormulation
formulations.rationale: Frame elements inherit beam formulation limitations; scheduled for post-V4.
